$schema: Each leaf is [light, dark]. `description` explains a non-obvious role; it is emitted as JSDoc and must be kept when a value changes. Seeded from finstocks-app hooks/ui/use-theme-colors.ts and utils/core/inkTokens.ts at c8f7925.

subtle.description: Dimmer than muted — captions and eyebrows.

hairline.description: A true 10% rule — stronger than subtle.

wash.$description: Alpha fills with no opaque equivalent: idle chips, empty-state tiles, KPI tiles.

warning.description: Light is a darkened amber: the dark palette's #f59e0b is 2.07:1 on the light ground, under the 3:1 WCAG 1.4.11 asks of an indicator and well under 4.5:1 as text; this clears both at 4.85:1.

pl.$description: Theme-aware P&L semantics for TEXT. Distinct from chart.positive/negative: tuned for legibility on both surfaces (light greens/reds are darker for contrast). Profit/loss colour stays reserved for money.

action.$description: Order-pad CTA chrome. Not pl/trade: a submit button is one control whose colour must not shift with buy/sell.

trade.$description: Directional DATA marks: candle bodies, OI bars, side badges, order arrows — not large button fills (those take action.*). Deeper and less saturated than status.success/error so they do not glare against the candle plot.

on.description: Glyph colour on a solid buy/sell fill — paired with that fill, not the page, which is what ink.inverse inverts against.

attn.description: "Worth a look", ranked below pl.loss. Carries regime words and conditions so profit/loss colour stays reserved for money.

primary.description: Brand inverts per theme: dark uses the soft lavender.

arc.description: Gauge strokes. Dark is a muted violet, not the brand lavender: that tone is tuned for text on near-black and reads far too bright as a 9px arc.

native.description: React Native shadowColor must be OPAQUE — opacity is applied separately via shadowOpacity. Substituting the rgba web token multiplies the alphas and the shadow vanishes.
